honest_c3: C1 — mac CPU fp32; numerical noise floor low but full forward of 64k-vocab × 768 head per token sweep is bounded by argmax and not soft-distribution; tie-breaking determinism not guaranteed across runs.

C2 — head_g is the cand-H aux head (BG-AF FAIL_TRUE evidence); designed for prev-byte prediction, NOT next-token chat. Coherent text via head_g would be a major surprise — incoherent text under head_g is the EXPECTED null and does not falsify lm_head per se.

C3 — tok_emb tied-embedding decode assumes embed-to-output weight tying. CLM v4 may have been trained WITHOUT tying (head_a stored as a separate Linear of identical shape suggests untied weights). If untied, tok_emb decode produces garbage by design — and coherent text would prove tying was effective; incoherent text is consistent with untied-by-construction and does not isolate lm_head pathology.

C4 — ln_f normalization applied uniformly via the forward hook. The hook captures POST-ln_f hidden, so all 3 explicit-head paths (head_a, head_g, tok_emb) operate on identically-normalized hidden. baseline_model_forward goes through the model's own lm_head path which should also be POST-ln_f; equivalence baseline ≡ head_a is the sanity check.
C5 — single prompt 안녕 (KO greeting). One-prompt result is anecdotal; broader prompt sweep needed before claiming 'lm_head broken across all inputs'. Per-prompt variance not measured here.
